tip: Place the conjugated verb 'ist' in position 2.

sentence: Hoffentlich ist es nicht das Herz!
translation_en: Hopefully it is not the heart!

sentence: Das ist sicher nicht so schlimm.
tip: Keep 'nicht so schlimm' together at the end of the sentence.
translation_en: That is certainly not so bad.

sentence: Frau Winkler kommt nicht, weil sie Magenschmerzen hat.
tip: In the 'weil' clause, put the conjugated verb 'hat' at the very end.
translation_en: Ms. Winkler is not coming because she has a stomach ache.

sentence: Mein Hausarzt hat heute keine Sprechstunde.
tip: Place the time word 'heute' before 'keine Sprechstunde'.
translation_en: My family doctor has no consultation hours today.

sentence: Deshalb muss ich bis morgen warten.
tip: After 'Deshalb', put the modal verb 'muss' in position 2 and 'warten' at the end.
translation_en: Therefore I have to wait until tomorrow.

sentence: Er will mir nichts sagen, weil meine Krankheit schlimm ist.
tip: Put 'sagen' at the end of the main clause and 'ist' at the end of the 'weil' clause.
translation_en: He doesn't want to tell me anything because my illness is serious.

sentence: Die Untersuchung hat nur fünf Minuten gedauert.
tip: Put 'hat' in position 2 and the participle 'gedauert' at the end.
translation_en: The examination only lasted five minutes.

sentence: Mein Herz ist völlig in Ordnung.
tip: Use the fixed expression 'in Ordnung' at the end.

sentence: Die Ärzte sagen einem nie die Wahrheit.
tip: Dative pronoun 'einem' comes before the accusative object 'die Wahrheit'.
translation_en: The doctors never tell you the truth.

sentence: Deshalb gehe ich gar nicht mehr hin.
tip: The separable prefix 'hin' goes to the very end of the sentence.
translation_en: That's why I don't go there anymore at all.

sentence: Du hast Probleme, weil du zu viel auf deinen Körper hörst.
tip: Put the conjugated verb 'hörst' at the end of the 'weil' clause.
translation_en: You have problems because you listen to your body too much.

tip: 'glauben' takes the dative object 'deinem Hausarzt' and stands at the end.
translation_en: You have to believe your family doctor.

sentence: Denk doch nicht dauernd an Krankheiten!
tip: Start the informal imperative sentence with the verb 'Denk'.
translation_en: Don't think about illnesses all the time!

sentence: Ich kann heute nicht kommen, weil ich Fieber habe.
tip: End the main clause with 'kommen' and the 'weil' clause with 'habe'.
translation_en: I cannot come today because I have a fever.

sentence: Ich habe Fieber, deshalb kann ich nicht arbeiten.
tip: Put 'kann' immediately after 'deshalb' and 'arbeiten' at the end.
translation_en: I have a fever, so I cannot work.

sentence: Was ist los? Ist alles in Ordnung?
tip: Two short questions to ask if someone is okay.

sentence: Oh, das tut mir wirklich sehr leid!
tip: Use 'das tut mir ... leid' to express sympathy.
translation_en: Oh, I am really very sorry about that!
